Hi Bob / Alice —

Following up with the technical details we discussed. I attached a draft VPC dataflow (acmehealth_vpc_diagram.pdf) and a short SOC2 summary. Below are the core points and configuration options.

1) Telemetry / Logging- Default: Redwood Private ships with telemetry that can be toggled per-deployment. For regulated tenants we support: 
  - Telemetry disabled: all agent metrics & model telemetry disabled; only critical operational logs stored locally.
  - Local log archival: logs are written to the customer's S3-compatible endpoint inside the VPC (or on-prem NFS) — no external endpoints required.
  - Audit access controls: logs are write-once + role-based access via your IAM. We provide built-in audit headers (user-id, request-id) and an option to redact PII from logs at collection time.

2) Egress controls- Options we recommend:
  - Strict deny egress with explicit allowlist for required upstreams (e.g., your KMS endpoint, internal model registry).
  - TLS termination remains inside the VPC; outbound DNS resolution can be restricted to your internal resolvers.
  - For agents that normally phone-home for updates/metrics, we provide an "air-gapped" bundle: no outbound connections, manual patching, and full ops runbook.

3) Data retention & KV cache- KV cache can be configured per-deployment with TTL and explicit flush policies. For PHI workloads we recommend TTL=0 (no persistent KV cache) or encrypted cache persisted inside your storage with KMS-managed keys. Retention settings for logs are configurable; we can provide an exportable immutable archive for compliance checks.

4) On-prem / Air-gapped- Differences from standard Private VPC:
  - Installer: container images + installer tarball (no external registry access).
  - Updates: offline patch process with signed artifacts.
  - Network: no external DNS or outbound allowed by default.
  - Support: we provide an installation runbook and a paid offline-support SLA for air-gapped installs.

Attachments included:
- acmehealth_vpc_diagram.pdf (dataflow diagram showing internal boundaries, where KMS sits, and optional egress chokepoints)
- redwood_privacy_whitepaper.pdf (privacy controls & PII handling)
